source.note: Wave 1, P1 #100 (gap-samurai): no free animated samurai was found, so this is a library kitbash of two finished CC0 entries. The body, rig, scale and clips are man-kimono (Kimono_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack, Nov 2019, OpenGameArt). The sword is the katana entry (Poly Haven Antique Katana 01 by Tal Swicegood, its glTF, .bin and diffuse texture fetched beside the zip and pinned by sha256). It is attached rigidly to the Fist.R bone (scale 1.7, about 0.9 m long at this size), with the blade along the bone axis that points out of the thumb side of the fist, tilted 30 degrees outward and 15 degrees toward the forearm, so it is held low and forward in idle and walk, raised in the punch guard and thrust forward on the strike, and lifted overhead in Victory. Clips are trimmed to the ones that read with a sword in hand (Defeat clutches the head, PickUp and Walk_Carry reach for objects, Shoot_OneHanded is a pistol pose). Height 1.75 m like man-kimono; the chibi big head is the artist's.
